nodes.title: Product artifact identity is defined by immutable IDs
nodes.text: Every product artifact is identified and referenced exclusively through its stable, immutable artifact ID; file paths, file names, titles and generated locations do not define identity, and an ID once assigned MUST never be reused for a different artifact.

nodes.title: Repository mutation is contained, planned, drift-safe and fails closed

nodes.title: Reverse relationships are derived, never manually maintained
nodes.text: Every relationship between product artifacts has exactly one canonical authored direction — one source artifact type, one frontmatter field, one allowed target set — and all reverse views are derived by tooling; users MUST NOT author or maintain reciprocal references.

nodes.title: SDD frameworks cite product knowledge but do not own product semantics
